sloka: प्रहर्षमीयुर्बहवस्तु वानराः प्रबुद्धपद्मप्रतिमैरिवाननैः।अपूजयन् राघवमिष्टभागिनं हते रिपौ भीमबले दुरासदे ।। ६.६७.१६६ ।।
transliteration: praharṣamīyurbahavastu vānarāḥ prabuddhapadmapratimairivānanaiḥ।apūjayan rāghavamiṣṭabhāginaṁ hate ripau bhīmabale durāsade ।। 6.67.166 ।।

translations.english: Arms broken, feet cut off, dilating his mouth like fire, shouting aloud like Rahu entering moon in the sky he rushed to Rama speedily.
